gr_list.description: Proactive Review Rescue: Risk assessment tracking + tenant-configurable rescue templates
Multilingual Medical Tourism: Treatment catalog + conversation tracking + Claude Haiku response generation

plan.summary: Extend Invekto.Marketing service with GR-3.24 Proactive Review Rescue (review_risks + rescue_templates tables, 8 CRUD endpoints) and GR-3.25 Multilingual Medical Tourism (treatment_catalog + tourism_conversations tables, Claude Haiku response generation, 8 endpoints). 4 new DB tables, 16 new endpoints, TourismResponseGenerator service, Backend proxy with MarketingProxyDelete helper.
plan.q_intent: PKT-6C3: GR-3.24 Review Rescue data layer in Marketing + GR-3.25 Multilingual Tourism with Claude Haiku response gen. Language-agnostic (no restrictions).
plan.interview_notes: 1) GR-3.24 scope: Marketing data layer only (not split across services). 2) GR-3.25 scope: Data layer + Claude Haiku response gen endpoint. 3) Language: agnostic (patient_lang column, no restrictions).

files_changed.change: 4 new tables: review_risks, rescue_templates, treatment_catalog, tourism_conversations
16 new endpoints + Claude DI + 8 request DTOs

verification_questions.question: Do all 16 new repository queries include tenant_id in WHERE clauses for multi-tenant isolation?
Are all new SQL queries using const string with parameterized queries (no string concatenation or interpolation)?
Does the TourismResponseGenerator gracefully degrade (return null) on Claude API failure without throwing exceptions to callers?
Are all new endpoints protected by JWT auth middleware and returning 401 for missing TenantContext?
Do the CHECK constraints in marketing-v2.sql match the validation logic in Program.cs endpoint handlers?
Are all 13 new error codes (INV-MK-011~023) properly used in the correct endpoint handlers with appropriate HTTP status codes?
Does the /api/v1/tourism/respond endpoint correctly persist the conversation record after Claude response generation?

non_goals: Automatic risk detection (sentiment analysis in ChatAnalysis)
Outbound trigger integration for rescue messages
Cultural adaptation layer (kept at prompt level)

error_handling.silent_failure_explanation: TourismResponseGenerator returns null on failure, endpoint returns explicit 503 with INV-MK-023. All NpgsqlException caught with 500 response. Claude timeout logged with elapsed ms.
